title: Estimated water cost of an AI chatbot conversation (milliliters)

source.name: Making AI Less Thirsty (Li, Yang, Islam, Ren, 2023)
source.publisher: University of California, Riverside / University of Texas at Arlington

notes: Researchers estimated a conversation of roughly 20-50 questions with a GPT-3-class chatbot consumes about 500 milliliters of water, counting both on-site cooling and the water used to generate the electricity.
